title: Routine

services.name: Pilates Teacher Training
services.desc: A quick note before we go any further: Routine is the host studio, not the certifying body. All education and certification are provided through Balanced Body. We’re simply offering our space as the home base for training here in Brunswick. To become fully Balanced Body certified, you will need to travel to Boston to complete Mat 3 and Reformer 3. this can be a combination of many different ways of teaching reformer, including getting paid to teach at Routine! We want to learn a little more about you, your schedule, and what you’re looking for before sending next

services.name: Mat Pilates
services.desc: Elegant, compact, and sneaky-effective. Chair classes blend balance, stability, and strength work through controlled, intentional movement. It’s an empowering challenge that builds deep functional strength and body awareness.We use Balanced Body EXO & Combo Chairs for a stable, high-quality experience.Classes: Chair I

services.name: Hot Yoga
services.desc: A restorative, grounding practice that blends breath, gentle flow, and mindful stretching. Ideal for easing stress, improving mobility, and pairing with Pilates or Strength for a well-rounded routine.Classes: Bikram (Hot), Hot Power Flow, Slow Flow

explain.meaning: Yoga in a heated room, often around 40 °C (105 °F).
